meta.title: La Orquídea y el Oso | Specialty Organic Coffee from Tierradentro, Cauca — South Africa Mission 2026
meta.description: Specialty organic coffee grown by smallholder families in Inzá, Tierradentro (Cauca, Colombia). Export-ready product, traceability and the O&O Certified Origin Program for buyers in South Africa and West Africa.

hero.eyebrow: Specialty Coffee — South Africa Ghana and Senegal Trade Mission 2026
hero.title: Coffee You Can Trace to the Farmer. Not Just the Country.
hero.subtitle: We grow, process and export specialty coffee directly from Inzá, Tierradentro — no reseller, no unverified "Colombian" label. Every lot is tied to the family that grew it, by name and lot. We're bringing that directly to South Africa and West Africa.

product.eyebrow: Verified Origin, Specialty Cup, Direct Relations
product.title: Exportable Product
product.text: Every lot we export — single farm or 200-farm blend — ships with the report behind it: where it grew, how it was processed, and the cup profile behind the score. Sold and shipped directly by the families who grow it. No creative traders in between.
product.bullet1: Cup profile and cupping notes documented, single origin or farms blend.
product.bullet2: Full producer report included — even on multi-farm blends.
product.bullet3: Exported directly by the growers, not through a trader.

origin.title: Every Bag Traces to Inzá, Tierradentro — Not Just "Colombia"
origin.text: In Inzá, Cauca, coffee grows inside a legally recognized Indigenous territory — the Yaquivá Reserve — alongside native forest and agroforestry systems. This isn't a claim we make in a brochure. It's a place you can find on a map, with families you can name.
origin.bullet1: 300+ partner farming families, each one identified.
origin.bullet3: A tradition passed down between generations, not a supply contract.

program.title: A Standard We Built, Not a Label We Bought
program.text: Third-party organic certification is expensive to maintain at smallholder volume — often too expensive to make sense. Instead, we score every lot ourselves through the O&O Index: origin and territory, sustainability practices, and verified quality. We use it to move each farm toward stronger practices over time, not just a passing grade.
program.video_note: Buyers who choose O&O back that progress directly. A platform to follow it lot by lot is coming.

traceability.title: Del Bosque a la Taza — Seis Etapas, Todas Documentadas
traceability.text: Cada contenedor que exportamos reúne café de decenas de productores de Inzá, Tierradentro, manteniendo la trazabilidad de cada lote. Sin mezclas que oculten el origen de quienes lo cultivaron. Así es como un lote recorre las seis etapas, desde el árbol hasta la documentación de exportación.
traceability.note: Nuestra herramienta de consulta por lote se encuentra actualmente en desarrollo. Solicite una vista previa a nuestro equipo durante la misión comercial.
